# Markit Media

> Markit Media is a full-stack digital marketing agency offering SEO, paid advertising and performance marketing, social media, website development, branding, video production and AI services. It serves businesses in the USA, Canada, UAE, UK, Australia and Saudi Arabia and is based in Karachi, Pakistan.

Contact: ciao@themarkitmedia.com | US phone +1 (606) 517-7561 | Phone / WhatsApp +92 300 2086081

## Services
- [All services](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services): complete service catalogue
- [SEO](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/seo): technical, local, content and authority SEO
- [Performance marketing](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/performance-marketing): Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and other paid media
- [Social media marketing](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/social-media): strategy, content, reels, community management
- [Website development](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/website-development): WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, landing pages and e-commerce
- [Branding](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/branding): brand strategy, identity and guidelines
- [Video production](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/video-production): video, reels and animation
- [AI services](https://themarkitmedia.com/en/services/ai): AI consulting, automation and marketing automation
